question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

He offered a great __**deal**__ on the used car.

options.text: The two countries signed a new trade deal.
The magician will deal out the cards for the trick.
I found a great deal on airline tickets.
The business deal was finalized this morning.

solution:
**The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. "The magician will deal out the cards for the trick."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

__
 
• The word **"deal"** has multiple meanings, making it a homonym. In English, "deal" can mean an agreement or transaction, or the act of distributing something. (समझौता या बांटना) 
 
 
• **Example 1: Transaction:** He offered a great deal on the used car. (The word "deal" here refers to a transaction or bargain.) 
 
• **Example 2: Distribution:** The magician will deal out the cards for the trick. (The word "deal" here refers to the act of distributing or handing out cards.) 
 
 
• In Option 2, "deal" refers to the act of distributing cards, which is a homonym of the highlighted usage in the question. 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. "The magician will deal out the cards for the trick."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:
 

 
• **Option 1:** "The two countries signed a new trade deal." 
 
 
• **Meaning:** Here, "deal" refers to an agreement or contract made between two parties. (समझौता) 
 
• **Example:** The two countries signed a new trade deal to improve economic relations. 
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "I found a great deal on airline tickets." 
 
 
• **Meaning:** Here, "deal" refers to a bargain or a good price for a product or service. (सौदा) 
 
• **Example:** I found a great deal on airline tickets for my vacation. 
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "The business deal was finalized this morning." 
 
 
• **Meaning:** Here, "deal" refers to a finalized agreement or negotiation between business parties. (व्यवसायिक समझौता) 
 
• **Example:** The business deal was finalized this morning after lengthy discussions.
